C9000368.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 368 (The three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem.; papers: Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for 1≤p≤2; Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for p>2; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN_HIGH.statement: The fixed-target strong diffeomorphic approximation theorem for every finite p>2. Only its cubical-cutoff dependency is examined here.

C_MAIN_LOW.statement: The fixed-target strong diffeomorphic approximation theorem for 1<=p<=2, whose proof modules are outside the present audit.

C_CUTOFF.statement: The full local conclusion of hp:cutoff with constants independent of h and s, including fixed image, energy, fibres, relative topological opening and property N.

C_IMMERSION.statement: A compatible finite-template orientation-preserving immersion near the cubical two-skeleton, with uniform derivative bounds and inverse charts.

C_FRAME_EXTENSION.statement: Full positive edge frames can be homotoped to scalar frames relative their end collars; the resulting face collar frames extend and Hirsch 5.7 applies relative a retained annulus.

C_TEMPLATE_UNIFORMITY.statement: Finitely many labeled edge and face data permit a common positive singular-value, Hessian, collar and inverse-chart margin, fixed before h and s.

C_LIFT.statement: The small inverse-branch lift is a global embedding on the retained skeleton neighborhood and satisfies the scale-free conjugation estimate.

C_PACKING.statement: At one depth lambda<=s, at most 24 b (A+d)^2/v times (s/lambda)^2 sampling balls cover a fixed point.

C_SAMPLING.statement: Inverse-Jacobian weights (lambda/s)^3 times the scale-wise packing bound have total weighted overlap at most 2 K_pack at all dyadic depths.

C_FILL_COLLAPSE.statement: Bicollared lifted hole spheres admit the correctly parametrized disjoint ball fillings; uniformly Lipschitz target collapses remove their uncontrolled energy without changing the image.

C_SEAMS_FIBERS.statement: Sobolev gluing holds at all seams including the limiting inner boundary; tame null ball fibres have the stated relative opening and property N is inherited.

C_EXACT_ALGEBRA.statement: Universal full-frame transport determinant, scalar determinant scaling, dyadic sum identity and weighted finite-depth bound; this formal core is not the whole cutoff.

C_HIGH_REMAINDER.statement: Remaining high-exponent preparation, carrier applications, quantizer, wall, mesh, assembly and smoothing modules. Not verified by the cutoff proof.

C_LOW_REMAINDER.statement: Low-exponent tools, assembly and smoothing modules. Independent of and outside the present cutoff audit.
